title: Zesty Crisp German Ackee Skillet
description: A yeasty and crisp German dish featuring ackee, perfect for a paleo-friendly breakfast, with a braise that brings out the flavors of the ackee and other ingredients.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced pork sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ackee, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle the active dry yeast over the top of the ackee mixture and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes, or until the yeast is fragrant and the mixture is crispy.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
